ñatvā.cp: abs. of jānāti. having known; having found out.
ñatvā.p: [Ñā+tvā] (kri,vi) CL=7 Know. (A) Have known. (B) Due to know. (C) Investigation and contemplation. (D) To weigh the pros and cons (or) To consider and contemplate, To decide.

D: Ñatvā，（【独】 从 jānāti），知道了，懂了，学会了。（p138）
B:
ñatvā： ñatvā（kri，vi）
ဉတွာ（ကြိ၊ဝိ）
[ñā+tvā]
[ဉာ+တွာ]

natvā： natvā（kri，vi）
နတွာ（ကြိ၊ဝိ）
[namu+tvā]
[နမု+တွာ]
C: ñatvā：[abs．of jānāti] having known； having found out．
U: ÑATVĀ：（[abs] của jānāti） được biết，hiểu，đã học hỏi
K:
natvā：နတွာ（ကြိ၊ဝိ）
[နမု+တွာ]
ရှိခိုး၍၊ ဦးညွတ်၍။
R:
ñatvā：ဉတွာ （အ-ကိတ်）
သိ၍။
ဂဗ်ဘဿ ပတိဋ္ဌိတဘာဝံ ဉတွာ၊ ကိုယ်ဝန်၏ တည်သောအဖြစ်ကို သိ၍။
NCP: absol. | ~natvaa of jānāti See also: jānāti

ñatvāna.p: [Ñā+tvāna] (kri,vi) CL=7 [Jānātītiñatvāna. Nettivi.245.] To know. (A) Have known. (B) Knowing. (C) Due to know. (D) To consider and contemplate, To decide. (E) To distinguish and memorize.
